title: A product page shows an outdated price after an update

initial_facts.text: A new price is committed on the primary, but a later API response has the old price.
The request path is reported to bypass the application cache for this operation.

public_evidence.text: The trace confirms the cache bypass flag was active for request P-22.
Request P-22 read from replica R2, whose replication position is behind the primary commit.
The primary has version 91 with the new price; replica R2 has version 90 with the previous price.
A later read from the same replica after it catches up returns version 91.

accepted_alternatives: Identify replica lag as supported by the version and routing facts.
Ask for replica position or a primary-versus-replica comparison before settling.
Recommend a bounded read-your-write path or consistency policy with an explicit trade-off; do not repeat cache invalidation as the cause when bypass is verified.
